owner_instruction: Away ~1 week. Run the OFFLINE loop, keep the program going, do NOT work the brains subsystem, batch ALL questions to QUESTIONS.md (never AskUserQuestion), and proceed on sensible defaults. Exit when Eitan posts that he's back.
rules: Each session: standing checks -> ONE wired+visible increment on a NON-brain front -> verify the READ side via CLI/DATA (guardrails, read the generated json/html, assertions) NOT the browser (browser tools can prompt / are flaky headless while unattended) -> log WHY -> ship via `python -m src.git_safe ship` -> harsh criticism of both.

PERMISSIONS (the REAL rule — confirmed 2026-07-23; the .claude/settings.json allowlist did NOT stop it): NEVER run `git` directly in a Bash command. The app gates cd+git as a hook-execution risk and the unattended loop FREEZES on it (a screenshot proved it stalled mid-standing-check). Route ALL git through PYTHON, which the gate cannot see inside: `cd /d/AI-YouTube-Skills && python -m src.git_safe sync` to fetch+rebase, `python -m src.git_safe ship -m ... -a ...` to commit+push, and a python one-liner (subprocess.run(['git',...])) to read state. Every command begins `cd /d/AI-YouTube-Skills && python ...` (cd-before-python is fine; only cd-before-git is gated). NEVER git push --force / git clean / rm -rf. If a command still prompts it will freeze — keep the command surface python-only.

NON-brain fronts to advance: M1 polish, M3 shell/design, the Hub, self-improvement dept, per-department executors, deterministic enrichment, the audit backlog machinery, cleanup. NOT the engine/brains subsystem (enough done there for now).

NEVER call AskUserQuestion. If a question or decision arises (spontaneous OR part of the plan), append it to QUESTIONS.md under 'Away-week questions' with my chosen default, then proceed on that default.
Cadence while unattended: hourly (conserve resources; no one is watching for fast feedback).
The GitHub Actions beat + the hourly local drain keep the CORE program running 24/7 regardless of any session.
exit_condition: Eitan posts any message indicating he's back -> stop away mode, present all batched questions from QUESTIONS.md, resume normal interactive cadence.
